Package aor.proj3t.websocket

Class AppWebSocket

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.websocket.AppWebSocket
@ApplicationScoped public class AppWebSocket extends Object
WebSocket Endpoint for Real-time Communication. This class provides a WebSocket server endpoint for real-time messaging and notification delivery between users. It handles connection authentication via JWT tokens and manages bidirectional communication for instant message delivery and status updates.

The WebSocket endpoint is designed to complement the REST API by providing instant delivery of messages and notifications. Messages are still stored and managed via REST endpoints, while WebSocket provides real-time delivery capabilities.

Key features:

  • Token-based authentication for WebSocket connections
  • Real-time message notifications
  • Message read status updates
  • General notification delivery
  • Automatic session cleanup on errors

WebSocket URL format: /websocket/{token}

  • Method Details

    • cleanup

      @PreDestroy public void cleanup()
      Cleanup method called before the application scope is destroyed.

      Ensures proper cleanup of JSON-B resources to prevent memory leaks.

    • onOpen

      public void onOpen(jakarta.websocket.Session session, String token)
      Handles new WebSocket connections.

      This method is called when a client establishes a WebSocket connection. It validates the provided JWT token, extracts the user ID, and registers the session for real-time communication.

      If authentication fails, the connection is immediately closed with an appropriate reason code.

      Parameters:
      session - the WebSocket session for the new connection
      token - the JWT token provided in the URL path for authentication

    • onClose

      public void onClose(jakarta.websocket.Session session, jakarta.websocket.CloseReason reason)
      Handles WebSocket connection closures.

      This method is called when a WebSocket connection is closed, either by the client or due to an error. It removes the user's session from the session manager to prevent memory leaks.

      Parameters:
      session - the WebSocket session that was closed
      reason - the reason for connection closure

    • onError

      public void onError(jakarta.websocket.Session session, Throwable throwable)
      Handles WebSocket errors.

      This method is called when an error occurs on a WebSocket connection. It logs the error and removes the user's session from the session manager.

      Parameters:
      session - the WebSocket session that encountered an error
      throwable - the error that occurred

    • onMessage

      public void onMessage(jakarta.websocket.Session session, String message)
      Handles incoming messages from WebSocket clients.

      This method processes various types of messages sent by clients through the WebSocket connection. Currently supports:

      • "mark_read" - marks a message as read

      Messages should be in JSON format with a "type" field indicating the message type and additional fields as required by each type.

      Parameters:
      session - the WebSocket session that sent the message
      message - the JSON message content sent by the client

    • notifyNewMessage

      public void notifyNewMessage(Long recipientId, Long messageId)
      Sends a new message notification to a specific user.

      This method is called by other parts of the application (typically message services) to notify a user when they receive a new message. The notification is sent only if the user is currently connected via WebSocket.

      Parameters:
      recipientId - the ID of the user who should receive the notification
      messageId - the ID of the new message

    • notifyMessageRead

      public void notifyMessageRead(Long messageId, Long senderId)
      Notifies a user when their sent message has been read.

      This method is called to inform the message sender that their message has been marked as read by the recipient.

      Parameters:
      messageId - the ID of the message that was read
      senderId - the ID of the user who sent the message (recipient of this notification)

    • notifyNewNotification

      public void notifyNewNotification(Long recipientId, String notificationType, String content)
      Sends a general notification to a specific user.

      This method is used to send various types of system notifications to users in real-time, such as evaluation updates, training announcements, or other application events.

      Parameters:
      recipientId - the ID of the user who should receive the notification
      notificationType - the type/category of the notification
      content - the notification content/message
